svg.text: Current R2 printable geometry · original Xiaomi magnetic/power base retained
Actual exported STL · 30 mm clamp depth
The printed VESA plate is the load-bearing “monitor substitute”.
No display is required above the lamp: the bracket mounts directly to a dedicated monitor arm’s VESA head.
Original 1S clamp, pogo-pin power path, magnetic mount and ± articulation remain unchanged.
Washers both sides · closed Ø4.5 mm holes
M4 screw → VESA arm plate → printed plate → washer + nyloc nut
Standalone only; no printed threads or second screw adapter.
Mock the top edge of a monitor, not the monitor itself
63 mm support width · 55 mm guide gap
Front and rear jaws provide the clamp force.
